title: Ritualist
text:
Ritualist is an Ascendancy class for the Huntress.


== Overview ==
The Ritualist has adopted the darker arts of the Azmeri. With Corrupted Lifeforce, she afflicts enemies with Blood Boils that spread Corrupted Blood on the victim's death and deals more damage against afflicted targets. With Wildwood Persistance, she can rapidly heal herself back from the brink. She can perform Ritual Sacrifice on slain monsters to steal their modifiers, or offer her own blood to gain a random monster modifier. The Ritualist can also specialize in items, enhancing her charms with Intricate Sigils and Mind Phylacteries, enhancing the effects of jewelry with Mystic Attunement, and even gain a third ring slot with Unfurled Finger.
